ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Blippo uses the camera to scan barcodes, QR codes and paper documents. For example, point it at a grocery barcode to see what the product is, or at a receipt to save it and copy the text out of it.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This identifier is used to show ads that are more relevant to you. Your scans and documents are never shared.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Blippo opens a photo you pick so it can read a barcode or QR code that is already in it — a ticket, a boarding pass, or a Wi-Fi code someone sent you as a picture.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Blippo saves a scanned page or a QR code image to your photos when you choose “Save Image” while sharing it.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Blippo uses Face ID to unlock the app, so your saved scans and documents stay private if someone else picks up your iPhone.
